C0527.title: Douyin Removes Over 1,000 Low-Price Non-Delivery Merchants
C0527.summary: In September 2025, Douyin E-commerce launched a special enforcement campaign against 'low-price non-delivery' and 'fraudulent shipment' violations, removing over 1,000 merchants and more than 200 affiliated creators. Some merchants used goods priced far below market value as low-price traffic bait, inducing consumers to order premium items while only fulfilling the premium items and never shipping the low-price goods, or used extended presale periods and fake logistics to fraudulently ship. The platform imposed store removal, settlement suspension, payment freezing, and penalty deductions on the violators.
